Name: CLEAN MAP - STANDARD FARM
Author: Karbantms
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3474]Froststar11's OCD Friendly Standard Farm Map[/url].
*[i]I took it a step further than Froststar by eliminating all grass and paths, and meticulously aligning cliffs and fences to ensure the entire map is perfectly squared.
[/i]
Originally made this mod for myself, but I decided to upload it.

[b]NOW IN GROWING COLLECTION![/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20952]CLEAN MAP - STANDARD FARM[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21249/]CLEAN MAP - BARN AND COOP[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21163]CLEAN MAP - GREENHOUSE[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21053]CLEAN MAP - QUARRY[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21263?tab=description]CLEAN MAP - CELLAR[/url]
[/list]
[u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u]:
Not compatible with mods that alter standard farm (Farm.xnb).
Compatible with mods altering spritesheets used by standard farm.

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]: (Just look at the images instead.)
[list]
[*]Removed all grass on walkable tiles, making them tillable.
[*]Removed all ponds, you can refill your water can next to totem.
[/list][list]
[*]Removed grass around the farmhouse and greenhouse.
[*]Removed the west cliff and lower-right corner cliff.
[*]Re-positioned fake trees to prevent map obstruction.
[*]Moved spouse outdoor area out of the way.
[*]Moved upper cliffs with shrine and cave to align right side of the map.
[*]Moved entry points to backwoods and forrest to the center of the map.
[/list]
"[i]What have you done! Map is too empty! You removed all the pretty details![/i]" - I know, main purpose of this mod is to allow players to decorate their buildable spaces as they want whether they use furniture or machines. (FACTORY MUST GROW... I mean sorry, wrong game...)[i]
[/i]
If I overlooked some sprites, let me know (nature cut in half, wrong sprites, etc.).
